title: Associate, Key Account Management (GrabFood)

reasons.love: Commercial rotation in FMCG / e-commerce, one of his preferred tracks.
reasons.good_at: F20 and F25 show leadership and communication in a student-run company; F26 shows Excel reporting.
reasons.needs: Stable employer, but the JD names no development path.
reasons.paid: THB 40,000-45,000 per month stated in the posting -> about THB 42,500/month.

summary: Good commercial fit with a clear growth path.
jd_text: Grab Thailand is hiring for Associate, Key Account Management (GrabFood) in Bangkok, Thailand. You will work with cross-functional teams, analyse sales and customer data, prepare weekly reports and present recommendations to managers. Requirements: bachelor's degree in any field (2026-2027 graduates welcome); good command of English and Thai; strong Excel; a team player who learns quickly. We offer structured training, mentoring and a clear career path.
